subject: HealthSync onboarding playlist and steward allocation
body:
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 01 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: HealthSync onboarding playlist and steward allocation

Team — quick pass on the HealthSync deal now that legal signed the SOW. High-level items up front and asks below.

Summary:
- Account: HealthSync (payer-provider integration startup)
- Deal: Dedicated capacity + Premier Support add-on, 12 month term, signed 2026-10-29
- Target go-live: 2026-12-15 (pilot feature set)
- Expected load: ~5k inference requests/day initially, spike to 20k/day in Q1
- Latency SLO: 99th < 150ms (customer stressed this point)
- Deployment: Private/managed VPC (customer requires VPC peering, SOC2 controls)

Known constraints / open items:
- HealthSync uses Okta SAML for SSO (Tom Rivera will coordinate org-admin access)
- They have strict data-retention and audit log requirements — will need our SOC evidence pack and log-forwarding plan
- Networking: they require specific egress IPs and a pre-approved tunnel; Legal included a carve for connectivity testing window
- Integration lead at customer: Tom Rivera <tom@healthsync.com> (ops@healthsync.com is the team alias)

Attachments: [Attachment: HealthSync_MAL_v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)] [Attachment: HealthSync_SOW_draft.pdf (pdf)]
Linked artifacts: HubSpot deal + onboarding S3 folder (links below)

Asks / next steps:
1) Nominate primary CSM and PM for the onboarding cadence. Prefer someone who can lead weekly ops calls and run the 30/60/90 plan.
2) SE review: need an initial architecture assessment + a short list of infra questions for the customer (networking, certificate management, KV cache sizing).
3) Security runbook: Karthik, can you flag any immediate SOC evidence gaps so we can start triaging?
4) Please confirm we can hit the 12/15 pilot — I marked this a hard milestone to align our internal QA window.

Related links:
- HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-8492
- Onboarding assets: s3://redwood-shared/healthsync/onboarding/

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Subject: Re: HealthSync onboarding playlist and steward allocation

Thanks Ben — this is helpful. A few clarifying questions before I commit to the schedule: 

1) Confirming deployment modality: you mentioned private/managed VPC — does the customer expect our Private product (customer VPC with our control plane) or Dedicated nodes in their cloud account? That affects the runbook.
2) Do we have a named procurement contact for network approvals (IP allowlist, tunnel windows)?
3) Are there any data-scoped exceptions (e.g., PHI) that would change the storage/retention plan?

My preliminary staffing suggestion: Monica as primary CSM for post-sign, Tessa as PM for the implementation sprints, and an SE for the first architecture review (I can loop in Lukas Meyer). Monica, how does your schedule look for a kickoff next week?

Karthik Iyer
Head of Customer Success, Redwood Inference

Karthik — quick answers inline to help you triage: 

1) Deployment: Customer expects Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool in their cloud region) but opted into our Private control-plane option for auditability — so we'll need the Dedicated infra runbook plus VPC peering checklist.
2) Procurement/network contact: Tom Rivera (tom@healthsync.com) is the ops lead and will coordinate with their networking team; he agreed to a connectivity window the week of 11/22.
3) Data scope: No PHI expected in tokenized payloads for the first phase; they did request audit logs and 90-day retention for certain usage metrics.
4) Support: Premier support add-on purchased — includes 24/7 incident escalation channel and 4-hour P1 response SLA.

Load and SLOs reiterated: start ~5k/day, scaling to 20k/day. 99th <150ms is a contractual expectation for the pilot.

HubSpot link and S3 folder again: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/HS-8492 | s3://redwood-shared/healthsync/onboarding/

Ben

Appreciate the summary, Ben. Quick staffing + next steps from the implementation side: 

- Primary CSM: Monica Patel — Monica, please own the weekly cadence, intake questionnaire, and success plan (30/60/90).
- Implementation PM: Tessa Morgan — I will run the sprint schedule and coordinate infra milestones.
- SE (architecture review): Lukas Meyer — please prepare a 60-minute tech assessment focused on network, certificate management, and cache sizing.

Monica: Can you run the intake call with Tom + ops next Wed (11/10) at 10am PT? If that works, book the invite and include a short pre-read: the MAL spreadsheet + list of top-10 security/infra questions.

Action items assigned: 
- Monica: schedule kickoff, populate initial 30/60/90 plan in the onboarding folder.
- Lukas: draft an architecture checklist (2 business days).
- Karthik: validate SOC evidence pack availability and flag any gaps (ETA 3 business days).
- Ben: provide any additional product/contract notes that need to be called out in the customer kickoff.

I will update the HubSpot deal with these owners and move the deal into the onboarding pipeline stage.

Tessa Morgan
Implementation Manager, Redwood Inference
